add.issue.name: Wake page: start an engine's web UI from a tile, Start button, wait on the holder's release (PR #30)

edit.description.md:
Operator (2026-10-19): "I dont need the server up in ComfyUI, but I also dont want to have to manually start the comfyUI service. It should be available to start and a fancy redirect option." Then: "make that page have a 'start' function for if it is offline (it should NEVER clash with another running process though so it should say like -- waiting Strata release or waiting llama release)".

PR https://github.com/T-Crypt/berth/pull/30 (branch feat/gui-wake):
- fix(cli): main builds again (gib collision) and `berth pull` is a command again (both lost in the #26/#28 merge).
- `berth gateway --gui-listen`, engine key `gui`: /gui/<engine> redirects when up; offline page lists the card's holders and offers Start; after Start it names the wait ("Waiting for strata release: finishing its current request") then redirects.
- `drain_slots` / `berth run --drain-slots`: Strata is drained at its /slots boundary instead of SIGTERM mid-request.
- proto.Lease.group so the page names llama-swap models by family.

Live on aphotic (branch build 7785bb2). Dynacat tile points at https://aphotic.tail2a8bb.ts.net:9796/gui/comfyui.

Open: proxy the UI on one Berth URL instead of redirecting (the rest of VISION item 57); a gateway restart stops the engines it started (it did once today).
